title: Your team: a lighter What changed, and form chips that fit
items: The What changed story is down to the rank move and each game: the preseason rank joins the move line, the season record moves to the form tile, and the power-rating footnote is now the Rating tile's tooltip.
Game lines are shorter: venue and opponent's power rank, then the model's and market's pregame chance.
The last-five form chips shrink to fit their tile, so the fifth game is no longer cut off at desktop widths, and tile notes wrap instead of trailing off.
